# lomi. security program (internal)

Operational artifacts for penetration testing and PCI DSS v4.0.1 readiness. These documents live under `.github/security/` (tracked in the monorepo); merchant-facing guidance stays in `apps/docs`.

| Document | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [asset-inventory.md](./asset-inventory.md) | Deployable services, domains, and attack-surface tiers |
| [cde-data-flows.md](./cde-data-flows.md) | Cardholder data environment boundaries and payment rails |
| [pentest-rules-of-engagement.md](./pentest-rules-of-engagement.md) | Authorized targets, exclusions, and contacts |
| [program-ownership.md](./program-ownership.md) | Roles, internal vs third-party testing decision |
| [pci-external-track.md](./pci-external-track.md) | QSA, ASV, acquirer, and provider AOC procurement |
| [pci-pentest-methodology.md](./pci-pentest-methodology.md) | PCI DSS Req 11.4.1 methodology outline |
| [remediation-retest-policy.md](./remediation-retest-policy.md) | Finding closure and change-triggered retest |
| [sandbox-pentest-runbook.md](./sandbox-pentest-runbook.md) | Risk-ordered sandbox test checklist |
| [gim-go-live-gate.md](./gim-go-live-gate.md) | Preconditions before enabling GIM / direct card rails |

Last updated: 2026-07-14.
